Flareon

Fire

Kanto · Generation 1

Flareon is a Fire-type Flame Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 25 kg. It evolves from Eevee. Its highest base stat is Attack (130), with a base stat total of 525.
